description: This file defines React components for SVG chess piece icons named KnightIcon and QueenIcon, used in a Tic-Tac-Toe frontend as visual representations for players, with customizable size, color, and style.

methods.name: KnightIcon
methods.description: React functional component rendering a scalable SVG icon for a knight chess piece, with customizable properties.

methods.description: React functional component rendering a scalable SVG icon for a queen chess piece, with customizable properties.
